design_reasoning.rationale: The project compares automated decisions with bounded suggestions and traces human authority through every state transition.

observable_requirements.description: Compare automation alternatives and define when suggestions require rejection, escalation, or reconsideration.
Implement the selected human-authority boundary as explicit review state transitions.

architecture_maintainability.rationale: Model adapters, evidence normalization, policy, review state, and audit records have explicit boundaries.

observable_requirements.description: Compose a model adapter with policy and persistence without granting the adapter mutation authority.
Permit only explicit proposed, accepted, rejected, and escalated transitions.

security_by_design.rationale: PII minimization, prompt separation, provenance, authorization, and unsafe-output handling map to implemented controls.

observable_requirements.description: Map sensitive input, prompt influence, unauthorized approval, and misleading output to controls.
Remove unnecessary identifying fields before constructing bounded model input.
Require provenance and confidence fields and route unsafe or incomplete suggestions to escalation.

testing_evidence.rationale: Tests cover unsafe output, missing provenance, low confidence, unauthorized transitions, PII minimization, and deterministic adapters.

observable_requirements.description: Exercise unsafe content, missing citations, uncertainty thresholds, and escalation outcomes.
Exercise invalid state transitions and preserve human approval authority.
Exercise direct and nested identifying input removal with explicit allowlisted fields.

documentation_operations.rationale: Setup, adapter configuration, human review, incident handling, audit export, and rollback are documented.

observable_requirements.description: Document bounded use, adapter configuration, review responsibilities, and non-guarantees.
Document unsafe-output containment, audit export, rollback, and recovery procedures.

repository_hygiene.rationale: Pinned dependencies, licensing, CI, model-card expectations, contribution, and security policies are committed.

observable_requirements.description: Commit deterministic dependency resolution for bounded review.
Publish a recognized license granting reuse and modification rights.
Define automated policy and unit checks without execution claims.
Document intended use, excluded decisions, evaluation gaps, and adapter obligations.
Require safety regression evidence for policy or model-boundary changes.

implemented_safeguards.threat: A model suggestion directly mutates a consequential review decision without human approval.
implemented_safeguards.control: The model adapter can only create a proposal; a separate state machine requires an authorized human transition.

implemented_safeguards.threat: Unnecessary identifying information is sent to the configured model adapter.
implemented_safeguards.control: An allowlist-based minimizer removes direct and nested identity fields before adapter invocation.

negative_boundary_cases.behavior: Reject acceptance attempts that lack an authorized human reviewer.
Escalate a suggestion that lacks source provenance or bounded evidence.
Remove identifying values nested inside otherwise allowed input structures.

track_evidence.rationale: AI is essential to producing bounded review suggestions while human authority, provenance, minimization, and escalation remain explicit.

known_limitations.description: The project cannot guarantee the factual quality or fairness of an externally configured model.
Domain-specific outcome evaluation remains the responsibility of each deploying organization.

excluded_runtime_claims: Whether the project builds or starts
Performance, scaling, or reliability under load
Ability to extend the system safely
